zh.topic_title: Cleanup operations underway as death toll from China floods hits 39

en.topic_title: Cleanup operations underway as death toll from China floods hits 39
en.topic_summary:
The death toll from devastating floods in southern China’s Guangxi region rose to 39 on Thursday, with nine people still missing, state media reported, as residents went about cleaning up.



Security personnel march during cleanup operations in Liulan village, in Hengzhou city, in China’s southwest Guangxi region on July 8, 2026. Photo: Greg Baker/AFP.



Extreme weather has wreaked havoc on southern and central China this week, bringing torrential rain and severe flooding to Guangx
